title: importfile
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, importid, importmapid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, recordsownerid_systemuser, recordsownerid_team.

completedon.description: Shows the date and time when the import associated with the import file was completed.

content.description: Stores the content of the import file, stored as comma-separated values.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

datadelimitercode.description: Select the single-character data delimiter used in the import file.

enableduplicatedetection.description: Select whether duplicate-detection rules should be run against the import job.

entitykeyid.description: Unique identifier of the Alternate key Id

failurecount.description: Shows the number of records in the import file that cannot be imported.

fielddelimitercode.description: Select the character that is used to separate each field in the import file.

filetypecode.description: Shows the type of source file that is uploaded for import.

headerrow.description: Shows a list of each column header in the import file separated by a comma.

importfileid.description: Unique identifier of the import file.

isfirstrowheader.description: Select whether the first row of the import file contains column headings, which are used for data mapping during the import job.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Shows the name of the import file.

parsedtablecolumnprefix.description: Shows the prefix applied to each column after the import file is parsed.

parsedtablecolumnsnumber.description: Shows the number of columns included in the parsed import file.

parsedtablename.description: Shows the name of the table that contains the parsed data from the import file.

partialfailurecount.description: Shows the number of records in this file that had failures during the import.

processcode.description: Tells whether the import file should be ignored or processed during the import.

processingstatus.description: Shows the import file's processing status code.

progresscounter.description: Shows the progress code for the processing of the import file.

relatedentitycolumns.description: Shows the columns that are mapped to a related record type (entity) of the primary record type (entity) included in the import file.

size.description: Shows the size of the import file, in kilobytes.

source.description: Shows the name of the data source file uploaded in the import job.

sourceentityname.description: Shows the record type (entity) of the source data.

statecode.description: Shows the status of the import file record.

statuscode.description: Shows the reason code that explains the import file's status to identify the stage of the import process, from parsing the data to complete…

successcount.description: Shows the number of records in the import file that are imported successfully.

targetentityname.description: Select the target record type (entity) for the records that will be created during the import job.

totalcount.description: Shows the total number of records in the import file.

upsertmodecode.description: Select the value which is used for identify the upsert mode.

usesystemmap.description: Tells whether an automatic system map was applied to the import file, which automatically maps the import data to the target entity in Micr…

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_importid_value.description: Choose the import job that the file was uploaded for.

_importmapid_value.description: Choose a data map to match the import file and its column headers with the record types and fields in Microsoft Dynamics 365.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user who is assigned to follow up with or manage the import file.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that the record owner belongs to.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the import file.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the import file.

_recordsownerid_value.description: Choose the user that the records created during the import job should be assigned to.
